saw_lines: Nobody buys a rain barrel or pond pump on impulse. Buyers pick by litres and fit, once a job is clear.
So the sale is won on the product page, where capacity and fit get compared, and buyers need a reason to order.
Your 16 Google text ads read like software error messages, with no size or price in the lines we read. Rewrite them around litres and fit, starting with Regenspeicher 350 l.
ads_1: Google ads led by litres and fit, starting with the 350 l rain barrel
